mo_brief.title: MAJOR ORDER
mo_brief.original: Liberate the designated enemy planets, which are highly likely to be harboring the dissidents responsible for sabotaging the TCS+.
mo_brief.translated: 释放指定的敌方行星，这些行星很可能窝藏着破坏TCS+的持不同政见者。

items.original:
VOID EXPANSION DETECTED

The expansion rate of the Void has accelerated, engulfing a substantial swath of outer galactic territory. 

Affected sectors have been further consumed by the spatial vacuum. Helldivers are advised to focus all attention on efforts to map the Void. Preventing its further expansion is of the utmost urgency.
items.translated:
探测到寂域膨胀

寂域的膨胀速度加快，吞噬了银河系外的大片领土。

受影响的行业已被空间真空进一步消耗。建议绝地潜兵将所有注意力集中在绘制寂域地图上。防止其进一步扩大是当务之急。

items.original:
ARSENAL AUGMENTATION

High Command has authorized use of the Orbital Laser  at the Void Source Planet for the next 24 hours.
items.translated:
ARSENAL AUMENTATION

最高司令部已授权在未来24小时内在寂域源行星使用轨道激光。

items.original:
SEASSE SCIENCE EXPEDITION SITREP

The elite 3-person team has entered the core chasm. 

High Command notes that while some personnel have begun weeping tears of chromatic, iridescent fluid, this is a standard, completely non-hazardous biological response to advanced scientific discovery. The remaining team members continue sprinting forward into the glorious blinding light.
items.translated:
西斯科学考察团

精英三人团队已进入核心裂缝。

最高指挥部指出，虽然一些人员已经开始流下彩色虹彩液体的眼泪，但这是对先进科学发现的标准、完全无害的生物反应。剩下的队员继续冲向耀眼的光芒。

items.original:
STRATEGIC OPPORTUNITY SEIZED

The Helldivers successfully achieved the required quotas to catalyze urgent research into Void Blossoms, delivering an absolute triumph for environmental enforcement.

Using data cross-referenced from other pacified worlds, the Ministry of Science has formulated a rudimentary chemical compound to impair these uncommonly hostile botanical assets. Utilizing tactical crop-dusting protocols, this will weaken Illuminate defenses on Seasse.
items.translated:
战略机遇被抓住

绝地潜兵成功地实现了所需的配额，以促进对寂域花朵的紧急研究，为环境执法带来了绝对的胜利。

科学部利用其他和平世界的交叉参考数据，研制出了一种基本的化合物，以削弱这些罕见的敌对植物资产。利用战术作物除尘协议，这将削弱光能者在西斯的防御。

items.original:
VOID EXPANSION DETECTED

The expanding perimeter of the Void has surpassed all projections. Massive swathes of galactic real estate have been consumed by the anomaly.

Any colonial populations within the engulfed coordinates are advised to work from home, where viable, and to otherwise uphold their professional commitments until notified otherwise.
items.translated:
检测到寂域膨胀

寂域的膨胀周长已超过所有投影。银河系的大片房地产已被异常现象吞噬。

建议被吞没坐标内的任何殖民地居民在可行的情况下在家工作，并在另行通知之前履行其职业承诺。

items.original:
NEW STRATEGIC OPPORTUNITY

Void Blossoms disperse toxic pollination, reshape worlds, and appear to invigorate Illuminate forces. Synthesizing chemical countermeasures to this invasive flora will reduce Illuminate planetary resistance on the source world of Seasse.

Helldivers: extract 1,500,000 samples on UVP DELTA, terminate 25,000,000 Vote Snatchers on HYDROBIUS, and complete 50,000 operations on UVP BETA to hasten urgent research.
items.translated:
新的战略机遇

寂域之花驱散了有毒的授粉，重塑了世界，似乎给光能者力量注入了活力。对这种入侵植物群采取综合化学对策将降低光能者对西斯源世界的地球抵抗力。

绝地潜兵：在UVP德尔塔提取1500000个样本，终止哈卓毕亚斯的25000000个抢票者，并在UVP贝塔完成50000次手术，以加快紧急研究。

items.original:
DSS STATUS UPDATE

The DSS has docked at Afoyay Bay. A workforce of eager legally-mandated volunteers has been transported from the CECOD (Center for the Confinement of Dissidence) secure relocation site to carry out manual bio-remediation.

The DURs (Dissidents-Undergoing-Reeducation) have also been tasked with restoring the DSS to match original inventory manifests, and report exceptional morale at this generous opportunity to earn atonement.
items.translated:
DSS状态更新

DSS已停靠在艾福亚湾。一群渴望法律授权的志愿者已经从CECOD（异见限制中心）安全的搬迁地点运送过来，进行人工生物修复。

DUR（接受再教育的持不同政见者）还负责恢复DSS，使其与原始库存清单相匹配，并在这个慷慨的赎罪机会中报告异常的士气。

items.original:
DSS STATUS UPDATE

To fully resolve minor navigational discrepancies aboard the DSS, High Command has remotely initiated a station-wide environmental optimization cycle.

This deep sanitization has successfully returned the vessel to sterile parameters and hereby concludes the DSS examination to a satisfactory standard. Remote helm controls have locked a direct vector to Afoyay Bay for routine maintenance and post-cycle ventilation.
items.translated:
DSS状态更新

为了完全解决DSS上的轻微导航差异，最高指挥部已远程启动了全站环境优化周期。

这种深度消毒成功地使容器恢复到无菌参数，从而使DSS检查达到令人满意的标准。遥控舵控制装置已将直接矢量锁定到艾福亚湾，用于日常维护和循环后通风。

items.original:
DSS STATUS UPDATE

The DSS has completed an unscheduled FTL jump toward Calypso, forgoing the standard administrative channels for requests of this nature.

While the crew's sudden interest in this sector is under review, the on-board Ministry of Truth examiners are commended for their diligence, encouraged to complete their audit, and reminded that High Command has remotely disabled any and all manual controls aboard the station until further notice.
items.translated:
DSS状态更新

DSS已完成向卡利普索的未计划超光速跃迁跳转，放弃了此类请求的标准管理通道。

虽然机组人员对这一领域的突然兴趣正在接受审查，但船上真相部的审查人员因其勤奋而受到赞扬，鼓励他们完成审计，并提醒最高指挥部在进一步通知之前已远程禁用空间站上的任何和所有手动控制。

items.original:
DSS STATUS UPDATE

The DSS has temporarily ceased any and all communication transmissions. Automated diagnostics confirm transceiver hardware is operating at 100% efficiency. 

High Command has officially attributed this ongoing silence to a mandatory, station-wide silent contemplation period. Normal communications, log updates, and official examiner reports will resume immediately upon its scheduled conclusion.
items.translated:
DSS状态更新

DSS已暂时停止任何和所有通信传输。自动诊断确认收发器硬件以100%的效率运行。

最高指挥部已正式将这种持续的沉默归因于一个强制性的、全站范围内的沉默沉思期。正常通信、日志更新和官方审查员报告将在预定结束后立即恢复。
